name: LinkedIn Jobs: Copy + Next
description: Copy the current LinkedIn job to your clipboard and save it as structured Markdown in Downloads/jobs-md (Alt+C), or auto-save every job on the current page at a human pace (Alt+A) — skipping promoted, already-saved and off-target postings. Then advance to the next job. Alt+G / Alt+Shift+G open your saved job search over the past 24 hours / past week.
